name: NEXT Collaboration
notes: Leadership left empty: the NEXT official site names Juan José Gómez Cadenas as spokesperson (src:next-official-site), but the validator requires a `leadership[].person_id` to resolve to an existing record, and person records (including unresolved-person placeholders) are out of scope for this wave; the sourced fact is recorded here as a note instead of a structured leadership row.

summary.plain: About 100 scientists from more than 20 institutions in six countries who built and run the NEXT xenon-gas neutrino experiment in Spain.
summary.technical: NEXT Collaboration: >20 institutions, ~100 collaborators, 6 countries (US, Spain, Portugal, UK, Israel, Germany) per the collaboration's own site; spokesperson Juan José Gómez Cadenas.
